seoTitle: Firefly Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Firefly test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Mal, Zoe, Wash, Inara, Jayne, Kaylee, Simon, River or Book — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the stubborn captain, the pilot with a joke for every crisis, or the mechanic who can fix anything? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, money and doing the right thing, and find out which Firefly character you are.

characters.name: Mal Reynolds
characters.title: The Captain
characters.summary: Stubborn, independent and loyal to your crew. You don't take orders from anyone, but you'd do anything for the people you call your own.
description: Like Mal, you value your freedom above everything. He's the captain and owner of Serenity, and a former sergeant who fought for the Independents in the war.
You bend the rules, but you don't break your word. Mal will smuggle or steal when he has to, but he's generally honest and loyal to his crew.
You're a cunning leader. Mal keeps his crew flying, whatever it takes.
characters.flaw: You're so stubborn that you'll pick a fight just to prove nobody owns you.
characters.signature: A sarcastic remark, a loyal crew and a plan that's mostly improvised.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse to do anything just because you asked

characters.name: Zoe Washburne
characters.title: The Warrior
characters.summary: Calm, tough and fiercely loyal. You keep your head when everything goes wrong, and you never leave anyone behind.
description: Like Zoe, you stay calm in a crisis. She's Serenity's second-in-command, and she served under Mal in the war.
You're loyal to the end. Zoe is almost unconditionally loyal to Mal.
You've got a softer side. Zoe is married to the ship's pilot, Wash, who calls her his "warrior woman."
characters.flaw: You keep your feelings so locked up that people forget you have them.
characters.signature: A steady hand, a level stare and very few words.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay so calm that you'd wonder if they cared at all

characters.name: Wash
characters.title: The Pilot
characters.summary: Funny, lighthearted and full of heart. You crack jokes in the worst moments, and you'd fly anywhere for the people you love.
description: Like Wash, you can find the funny side of anything. He's Serenity's pilot, and he jokes even when things look hopeless.
You chase the view. Wash became a pilot so he could see the stars, which he couldn't see from his polluted home world.
You love with your whole heart. Wash is deeply in love with his wife, Zoe.
characters.flaw: You get a bit jealous of the people your partner is close to.
characters.signature: A bad joke, a steady hand on the controls and a window full of stars.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a joke while you were trying to be serious

characters.name: Inara Serra
characters.title: The Companion
characters.summary: Graceful, dignified and compassionate. You can handle any room, and you make people feel truly understood.
description: Like Inara, you carry yourself with grace. She's a Companion who rents one of Serenity's shuttles.
You open doors for others. Inara's status gives the crew a respectability they wouldn't have without her.
You keep things complicated. Inara and Mal have a romantic tension that neither of them quite admits to.
characters.flaw: You keep your heart guarded, even from the people who matter most.
characters.signature: A graceful smile, perfect manners and a polite way of saying no.
characters.clashReason: they'd make you feel underdressed, without saying a word

characters.name: Jayne Cobb
characters.title: The Mercenary
characters.summary: Tough, blunt and always watching out for number one. You're smarter than you let on, and softer too.
description: Like Jayne, you go where the money is. He's a mercenary who switched sides to join Mal because Mal offered him a better cut.
You're smarter than you look. Jayne seems oafish, but he's sharper than he lets on.
You've got a soft spot for home. Jayne sends much of his money to his mother, and proudly wears the knitted hat she sends him.
characters.flaw: You look out for yourself first, and everyone else second.
characters.signature: A big gun, a knitted hat and an eye on the payday.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask what's in it for them, every single time

characters.name: Kaylee Frye
characters.title: The Heart of the Ship
characters.summary: Sweet, cheerful and brilliant with your hands. You see the best in everyone, and you can fix almost anything.
description: Like Kaylee, you're a natural with machines. She's Serenity's mechanic, and keeps the ship running with no formal training at all.
You're completely genuine. Kaylee is known for her sweetness, and she's often called the heart of the ship.
You wear your heart on your sleeve. Kaylee has a crush on Simon, the ship's doctor.
characters.flaw: You trust people so easily that you can get hurt.
characters.signature: Grease on your hands, a big smile and an engine that purrs.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay cheerful while you're trying to be grumpy

characters.name: Simon Tam
characters.title: The Doctor
characters.summary: Brilliant, proper and devoted to your family. You'd give up everything for the people you love, even if you're awkward about showing it.
description: Like Simon, you're brilliant at what you do. He was a top-ranked trauma surgeon.
You'd give up everything for family. Simon walked away from his career to rescue his sister, River.
You're a little awkward with romance. Simon's clumsy attempts to woo Kaylee run through the whole series.
characters.flaw: You're so focused on looking after others that you forget to live your own life.
characters.signature: A medical kit, perfect manners and a sister you'd do anything for.
characters.clashReason: they'd be very polite, and very obviously disapproving

characters.name: River Tam
characters.title: The Prodigy
characters.summary: Brilliant, unpredictable and impossible to read. You notice what everyone else misses, and you say things nobody else would.
description: Like River, you're brilliant. She's a child prodigy, and Simon's younger sister.
You see what others miss. River is a "reader," with psychic abilities.
You're more dangerous than you look. River has a natural gift for hand-to-hand combat.
characters.flaw: You say exactly what you see, even when nobody's ready to hear it.
characters.signature: A faraway look, a sudden insight and an answer to a question nobody asked yet.
characters.clashReason: they'd say the thing you were hoping nobody had noticed

characters.name: Shepherd Book
characters.title: The Shepherd
characters.summary: Wise, calm and full of quiet faith. You're everyone's moral compass, and you've got more of a past than you let on.
description: Like Book, you're the moral compass of the group. He's a Shepherd, a travelling preacher, and the crew's moral guide.
You've got a mysterious past. Book has unexplained knowledge of crime, police corruption and military tactics.
You can handle yourself, but you won't kill. Book is a skilled fighter who still objects to killing.
characters.flaw: You keep your own secrets, even while you help everyone else with theirs.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a well-worn book and a past you don't talk about.
characters.clashReason: they'd gently point out where you went wrong

questions.text: Your boss tells you to follow a rule that makes no sense. You...

options.text: Ask why, over and over, until someone explains
Do what the person you trust tells you, no questions
Follow it properly, then quietly complain about it
Ignore it, unless someone's watching
Fix it yourself, and enjoy every minute
Make a joke, then call someone who knows what they're doing
Read the instructions very carefully, twice
Hit it until it works
A long bath, and an afternoon of peace and quiet
Sunshine, a picnic and something sweet to eat
Going somewhere, anywhere, just for the view
A long walk, and some time with a good book

questions.text: Someone offers you a lot of money to betray a friend. You...

options.text: Think about it. Seriously think about it
Refuse, and make sure they never ask again
Refuse without blinking
Decline gracefully, and remember their name

questions.text: You're caught in a tense standoff. You...

options.text: Stay perfectly calm, and wait for your moment
Quietly start planning your escape route
Notice something nobody else has spotted
Talk your way out, with a lot of bluffing

questions.text: A friend is feeling down. You...

options.text: Cheer them up. You always see the bright side
Listen, and make them feel truly understood
Share some wisdom, and a bit of perspective
Awkwardly pat them on the shoulder, then leave

questions.text: You get the chance to start over somewhere new. You...

options.text: Pick somewhere nobody can tell you what to do
Give up everything, if it keeps your family safe
Go. Everyone deserves a second chance
Stay put, unless your people are going too

questions.text: You're invited to a very fancy party. You...

options.text: Work the room like you were born to it
Say the wrong thing, and end up in a fight
Love every second, and compliment everyone's outfit
Hover by the food, and leave the second you can

questions.text: Someone in your family is in serious trouble. You...

options.text: Drop everything, even your career, to help them
Send them money
Act strangely calm, then do something nobody expected
Grab what you need, and go and get them

questions.text: A stranger needs help, but helping could get you in trouble. You...

options.text: Help them. It's the right thing to do
Grumble the whole way, but help anyway
Walk straight up to them, before anyone can stop you
Hesitate. Getting shot at isn't your idea of fun

questions.text: You're on a small spaceship, and the crew takes in two fugitives the government is hunting. You...

options.text: Let them stay. Nobody hands people over to the government on your ship
Ask, very nervously, how wanted they are exactly
Make them feel welcome right away
Vouch for them, even though you've got secrets of your own

questions.text: You wake up able to read people's minds. You...

options.text: Say what everyone's thinking, out loud, at the worst moment
Use it gently, to understand people better
Keep it to yourself. Information is an advantage
Look for a scientific explanation
